plain_english_policy: This bill is a **ceremonial, non-policy legislative action** with no substantive policy implications. It does not alter laws, funding, or governance—it merely renames a section of Alabama Highway 113 to honor Dewey J. Bondurant Jr., a local figure in Flomaton whose advocacy helped secure the highway’s construction as a hurricane evacuation route.
policy_direction_if_enacted: None. The bill is purely symbolic and administrative, with no broader policy effects on infrastructure, energy, or public safety beyond the ceremonial renaming of a road segment.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsors advanced this bill to honor Bondurant Jr. and recognize his role in the highway project, but the text does not reflect broader policy stances on infrastructure or energy.
evidence_quotes: WHEREAS... a joint project between Alabama and Florida will provide 13.5 miles of four-lane divided highway... this project is the culmination of more than four decades of hard work...
BE IT RESOLVED BY THE LEGISLATURE... That the portion of Alabama Highway 113... is hereby named the Dewey J. Bondurant, Jr. Highway...
review_reason: The bill’s text and metadata are clear and unambiguous.
